span.p:
Mesh / peer-to-peer
Many roots or peers; trust is local or pairwise.
Flexible — scaling needs shared directories or strict out-of-band discipline.

span.p:
Hierarchical · classic PKI tree
Root delegates to intermediates; path validation walks the chain.
Fits organisations and scoped delegation.

span.p:
Star / hub–spoke
Central registry, CA, or IdP — all spokes depend on one hub.
Simple operations; single point of trust, failure, or capture.
